audience: accounting practices managing client records, jobs and follow-up notes in Senta

useCases.title: Review a client and their contacts
useCases.text: Find a client by keywords, then inspect the client record and the contacts and fields configured by the practice.

useCases.title: Review overdue work
useCases.text: List jobs with overdue status, optionally narrowed to a client or job template, to review which work needs attention.

useCases.title: Record a client follow-up
useCases.text: Find the intended client and add the requested note, optionally linked to one of their jobs. This creates a note in Senta.

useCases.title: Update selected client details
useCases.text: Read the current client, then submit the requested field or contact changes. Updating client state or enabling a service can start jobs in Senta.
